newsitem.title: USA: Death toll reaches nine in Pennsylvania fire.
newsitem.headline: Death toll reaches nine in Pennsylvania fire.

text.p: Nine people were killed in a fire that raced through a Pennsylvania convalescence centre Wednesday, officials said.

Luzerne County Deputy Coroner Joseph Shaver said six residents burned to death, while three others died of heart attacks. Nine people were being treated in a hospital for injuries suffered in the fire, authorities said.

Authorities were investigating whether a boiler explosion Tuesday night might have caused the fire. The building housed 21 residents in Harvey's Lake, Pennsylvania, about 130 miles northwest of hiladelphia.
The home had been purchased 13 days before the fire by W.P. Equities Inc., of Kingston, Pennsylvania.
"It's our biggest nightmare come true," company chief executive officer Paul Pugliese said.
